chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-‘Abbas ibn Musa, from ‘Abd al-Rahman, from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar, from al-Mu‘alla, who said:
I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام about a man who had intercourse with a woman, and she transferred his fluid to a virgin slave-girl, and the slave-girl became pregnant.
So he عليه السلام said: “The child belongs to the man; upon the woman is stoning, and upon the slave-girl is the prescribed punishment.”

key_terms.ٱلْوَلَدُ لِلرَّجُلِ: the child is legally attributed to the man

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman transfers a man’s semen to a virgin slave-girl and she becomes pregnant?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning paternity and penal consequences in a case involving illicit sexual conduct and the transfer of semen leading to pregnancy. It establishes the child’s attribution to the man and assigns distinct hadd punishments to the two women according to their legal status and involvement.
